messages:
Renee - People Ops: Announcing a 6-month voluntary Sabbatical Pilot + Return-to-Work Coaching available starting today. Objective: recharge senior ICs and managers while preserving career continuity. Details + eligibility: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/sabbatical-pilot

Omar - People Ops: TL;DR: up to 8 weeks unpaid sabbatical (paid option evaluated case-by-case), guaranteed role hold for 90 days after return, and 4 coaching sessions within 60 days of return. Managers: submit FTE cover plan when approving.

Jules: Nice. Question: who qualifies as "senior"?

Renee - People Ops: Good Q  eligibility = full-time employees with 4+ years at Redwood or ICs/managers at equivalent seniority. Exceptions possible; send cases to people-ops.

Asha: If someone takes 8 weeks, does PTO accrue?

Omar - People Ops: During unpaid sabbatical, standard accrual pauses. If paid option is approved, accrual continues. We cover benefits continuation (medical) for the pilot under the same terms as short leaves; see policy.

Jules: How do we start an approval? Manager workflow?

Renee - People Ops: Employee starts the request in Workday > Time Off > Sabbatical Pilot. Manager reviews and uploads cover plan (can be a short note). People Ops reviews within 5 business days. For urgent timing, DM people-ops and well expedite.

HR-Bot: Official policy uploaded: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/sabbatical-pilot.pdf. Coaching vendor details and booking links at the bottom.

Asha: Love the coaching support 44dWill the coaching be tailored for managers returning to hiring/people ops tasks?

Omar - People Ops: Yes  we have manager and IC tracks. Coaches will cover onboarding back to projects, performance calibration, and update syncs with stakeholders.

Renee - People Ops: Hosting an info session Thurs 10:30am PT for managers + individual drop-in Friday 3pm PT. RSVP link in doc. Thanks all! :sparkles:
